newsitem.title: USA: GE Capital Services buys Potamac Federal.
newsitem.headline: GE Capital Services buys Potamac Federal.

text.p: GE Capital Services said on Tuesday it acquired Potomac Federal, which specializes in structuring and arranging financing for vendors to agencies of the federal government, for undisclosed terms.
Potomac Federal would keep its name and remain based in McLean, Va. It would join GE Capital's vendor financial services business, GE Capital said in a statement.
GE Capital is a unit of General Electric Corp.

"Potomac Federal and GE Capital Services complement each other very well in terms of vendor financing," Steve Bennett, vice president and general manager of GE Capital's vendor financial services, said.
Vendor financial services provides global financing and related services to manufacturers, dealers and distributors, and end-users in a variety of industries.
